entries.test: Whether there were documented 2023 reports of low-quality GPT-generated books being sold on Amazon in significant numbers.
entries.note: 'Infested' is loaded wording, but the plain reading is that AI-generated low-quality books were proliferating on Amazon.

entries.test: Whether there were documented reports by mid-August 2023 of inaccurate, hastily produced books about recent events being sold on Amazon, such as books about the Maui wildfires.
entries.note: The embedded example isn't in the text; the claim is likely about AI-generated books on the 2023 Maui fires.

entries.test: Whether there were documented cases, such as the August 2023 Pak'nSave meal-planner bot suggesting a recipe that makes chlorine gas, of LLMs producing dangerous or terrible advice.
entries.note: The cited recipe is probably the Pak'nSave bot incident.

entries.test: Whether there are documented cases of false content made up by one LLM being reproduced as fact by other LLMs or AI search systems.
entries.note: This is a general claim with no deadline, and documented cases of LLM-to-LLM contamination already exist, so it can be judged now.
